Main
================================================================================

John Zobolas {#title}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

<p style="text-align:justify; background-color:#e1d8f0; border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px;">
<b>Researcher in Clinical AI and Computational Statistics</b> with a background in computer science, software engineering and computational biology.
My research focuses on machine learning for <b>cancer research</b>, particularly <b>survival analysis</b> and high-dimensional <b>biomarker discovery</b>.
I am a core contributor to the open-source <a href="https://mlr-org.com/">mlr3</a> R ecosystem for machine learning and maintainer of <a href="http://github.com/mlr-org/mlr3proba">mlr3proba</a> and several CRAN packages, including <a href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/CoxBoost/index.html">CoxBoost</a> and <a href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/fastVoteR/index.html">fastVoteR</a>.
</p>
